claims.statement: Management expects non-engine/non-auto components to reach 25% of revenue in about a year, later than the earlier FY25 target.
Standalone business growth not expected to be double-digit immediately; significant new contracts to start production in next 12-24 months.
EMOSS Europe growth will be muted over coming quarters due to recessionary environment.
Retrofit EV business in India targets 20-25% gross margin and 10-15% operating margin at scale of 4,000-5,000 vehicles per year.
OEM EV manufacturing in India is 2-3 years away, using retrofit powertrain data.
Standalone Q4 FY24 EBITDA margin 17%, PAT margin 11%; domestic sales exceeded exports (53% vs 47%) lowering realizations.
Consolidated Q4 FY24 EBITDA margin ~10%, PAT margin ~1.2%.
New foundry and machine shop awards ensure full capacity utilization for next 4-5 years; new assembled camshaft plant in Solapur based on strong order book.
MEMCO secured additional business from key customers in fuel injection and critical instrumentation.
MFT Germany awarded new HVAC customer business for high-volume components starting production this calendar year.
PCL India ramped up non-engine brake component volumes; shipping commercially for last 2-3 months with higher volumes expected.
Setting up new assembled camshaft plant in Solapur; adding new machining lines for new contracts starting production in 12-24 months.
Retrofit satellite conversion workshops may open this financial year based on critical volume; currently outsourcing to partners.
PCL India cast 6.98M camshafts in FY24 vs 5.8M in FY23; machined 2.98M vs 3.1M.
Retrofit conversion time reduced to 8-10 hours per vehicle in India via process standardization and supply chain simplification.
Management will not provide forward-looking numbers for domestic camshaft growth; will follow industry trend
Confirmed purchase orders received from large pan-India customers for all 3 retrofit LCV variants
Commercial deliveries started in Pune, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Delhi; under 100 vehicles delivered YTD
PCL standalone capex INR 70-80 crores in next 6-12 months for new plant and assembled camshaft machining lines
PCL maintenance capex INR 3-5 crores regularly
New plant and machining facilities for won camshaft orders to start end of FY25 and next year

New plant construction underway, expected ready in 2 months plus 10-12 months for machine setup
New plant contracted for 70,000-80,000 machine camshafts per month with significantly higher installable capacity
Non-engine braking system parts already productionized for European OEMs, volumes below plan due to slowdown
Approximately 5,000 vehicles across 5 retrofit customers represent potential fleet conversion

India EV heavy vehicle electrification first vehicles on road in next two quarters

New camshaft capacity for awarded projects with SOPs in late 2025 or 2026; import substitution for running engines

Assembled camshaft capacity targeted at 50,000-70,000 parts per month

Consolidated EBITDA margin 10.83%, PAT margin -3% in Q3 FY25
